title: Reinventing Authorization - The Open Source Startup Podcast
summary: Learn about the Google Zanzibar approach, AuthZed's focus on large-scale applications, and how a Hacker News launch propelled SpiceDB growth.
body_markdown: AuthZed's CEO and co-founder Jake Moshenko is interviewed at The Open Source Startup Podcast. Learn about the Google Zanzibar approach, AuthZed's focus on large-scale applications, and how a Hacker News launch propelled SpiceDB growth.
